abstract: We report the anesthetic management of a low birth weight infant (1912 g including the tumor) with a giant sacrococcygeal teratoma (Altman type II). The diagnosis was prenatally made at 24 weeks of gestation. She was delivered by emergent cesarean section at 28 weeks gestation, because fetal heart failure was aggravated by arteriovenous shunting through the tumor. Total resection was planned on day 0. Her trachea was intubated via nasotracheal route to prevent accidental extubation during surgery, which was performed in supine and prone position. A central venous line (5 Fr. double lumen) was inserted via right internal jugular vein for monitoring central venous pressure (CVP) and for rapid volume infusion. We infused volume to keep CVP at 10 mmHg throughout the surgery. The resected tumor weighed 766 g, total blood loss was 770 ml and blood transfusion was 965 ml. Although transient acidosis and hyperkalemia occurred, the surgery was completed and she was transferred to a neonatal intensive care unit in stable condition. In this case, nasotracheal intubation and the insertion of a central venous line were necessary and useful for the anesthetic management of the resection of giant sacrococcygeal teratoma.
abstract_ja: 巨大仙尾部奇形腫(Altman II型)を有する低出生体重児(腫瘍を含めて1,912g)の麻酔管理を報告する。胎児期に妊娠24週で診断された。腫瘍を介した動静脈シャントにより胎児心不全が悪化したため、妊娠28週で緊急帝王切開により出生した。出生日に全摘出術を予定した。手術中の不慮の抜管を防ぐため経鼻気管挿管を行い、手術は仰臥位と腹臥位の両方で施行された。右内頸静脈から中心静脈カテーテル(5Fr二腔)を挿入し、中心静脈圧の監視と急速輸液に用いた。中心静脈圧を手術中ずっと10mmHgに保つように輸液を行った。切除された腫瘍の重量は766g、総出血量は770ml、輸血量は965mlであった。一過性のアシドーシスと高カリウム血症が生じたが、手術は完遂され、患者は安定した状態で新生児集中治療室へ移送された。本症例では、巨大仙尾部奇形腫の切除の麻酔管理において、経鼻気管挿管と中心静脈カテーテル挿入が必要かつ有用であった。
